component: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor (GPIO23 TRIG, GPIO24 ECHO via 1kΩ/2kΩ divider)
reason: Physical Raspberry Pi GPIO not detected on this host. Run on Raspberry Pi 4 or pass `--simulate` to test software filter logic only.
wiring_guide:
HC-SR04 to Raspberry Pi 4B / 5 Wiring Guide (BCM Numbering):
  1. VCC  -> Physical Pin 2  (5V Power)
  2. TRIG -> Physical Pin 16 (GPIO 23)
  3. ECHO -> Physical Pin 18 (GPIO 24) MUST use voltage divider (1kΩ + 2kΩ) to step 5V down to 3.3V
  4. GND  -> Physical Pin 6  (Ground)
